entities.name: eight hundred and thirty-six roubles and forty copecks

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: No one knew about the signals except my father, Smerdyakov, and me: that was all.

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: Besides, what motive had he for murdering the old man? Why, he’s very likely his son, you know—his natural son. Do you know that?

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: Minutely and diffusely Mitya told them everything about the signals invented by Fyodor Pavlovitch for Smerdyakov.

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: Scarcely had Mitya described how, sitting on the wall, he had struck Grigory on the head with the pestle, while the old man had hold of his left leg

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: seeing his father peering out of the window, his hatred flared up and he pulled the pestle out of his pocket

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: he pulled the pestle out of his pocket

triples.subject: Mitya Karamazov
triples.quote: Scarcely had Mitya described how, sitting on the wall, he had struck Grigory on the head with the pestle

triples.subject: Mitya Karamazov
triples.quote: “And the pestle?” “The pestle was in my hand.”

triples.subject: Mitya Karamazov
triples.quote: So I went to redeem the pistols I had pledged, to load them and put a bullet in my brain to-morrow.

triples.subject: Mitya Karamazov
triples.quote: I had a note in my pocket already. I wrote it at Perhotin’s when I loaded my pistols. Here’s the letter.

triples.subject: Mitya Karamazov
triples.quote: I was in want of ten roubles and pledged my pistols with Perhotin

triples.subject: Mitya Karamazov
triples.quote: went to Madame Hohlakov to borrow three thousand which she wouldn’t give me

triples.subject: Mitya Karamazov
triples.quote: Mr. Perhotin informed us that when you came to him, you held in your hands ... your blood-stained hands ... your money ... a lot of money ... a bundle of hundred-rouble notes

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.object: eight hundred and thirty-six roubles and forty copecks
triples.quote: They counted the money, which amounted to eight hundred and thirty-six roubles, and forty copecks.
